mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any monetary regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that increases consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1800.0 thousand units indicates robust housing market activity that supports consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1800.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 1900.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signals strong housing demand that accelerates consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1900.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates supply chain disruptions reducing corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO increase and RSAFS decline) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines.
